mapper.select: select ad.document_id as documentId , ad.writer_id as writerId , ad.fault_id as faultId , ad.inspection_id as inspectionId , ad.document_type as documentType , ad.title , ad.content , ad.estimated_cost as estimatedCost , ad.status , ad.created_at as createdAt , ad.updated_at as updatedAt , ad.completed_at as completedAt , wm.member_name as writerName , we.employee_no as writerEmployeeNo , wm.user_type as writerUserType , wd.department_name as writerDepartmentName , we.position_name as writerPositionName , f.title as faultTitle , f.status as faultStatus , f.severity as faultSeverity , s.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.status as chargerStatus , i.inspection_result as inspectionResult , i.description as inspectionDescription , pending.approver_id as currentApproverId , pending_member.member_name as currentApproverName , pending_member.user_type as currentApproverUserType from approval_document ad join employee we on ad.writer_id = we.employee_id join app_member wm on we.member_id = wm.member_id left join department wd on we.department_id = wd.department_id left join fault_report f on ad.fault_id = f.fault_id left join charging_station s on f.station_id = s.station_id left join charger c on f.charger_id = c.charger_id left join inspection i on ad.inspection_id = i.inspection_id left join lateral ( select al.* from approval_line al where al.document_id = ad.document_id and al.status = '대기' order by al.approval_order asc limit 1 ) pending on true left join employee pending_employee on pending.approver_id = pending_employee.employee_id left join app_member pending_member on pending_employee.member_id = pending_member.member_id where ad.document_id = #{documentId}

select al.line_id as lineId , al.document_id as documentId , al.approver_id as approverId , al.approval_order as approvalOrder , al.status , al.comment , al.signature_data as signatureData , al.approved_at as approvedAt , m.member_name as approverName , m.user_type as approverUserType , e.employee_no as employeeNo , d.department_name as departmentName , e.position_name as positionName from approval_line al join employee e on al.approver_id = e.employee_id join app_member m on e.member_id = m.member_id left join department d on e.department_id = d.department_id where al.document_id = #{documentId} order by al.approval_order asc

select ah.history_id as historyId , ah.document_id as documentId , ah.employee_id as employeeId , m.member_name as employeeName , ah.action_type as actionType , ah.before_status as beforeStatus , ah.after_status as afterStatus , ah.comment , ah.created_at as createdAt from approval_history ah join employee e on ah.employee_id = e.employee_id join app_member m on e.member_id = m.member_id where ah.document_id = #{documentId} order by ah.created_at asc, ah.history_id asc
select employee_id from employee where member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1
select e.employee_id from employee e join app_member m on e.member_id = m.member_id where e.status = 'ACTIVE' and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and m.user_type = #{userType} order by e.employee_id asc limit 1
select count(*) from approval_document where fault_id = #{faultId} and status in ('상신', '1차승인', '최종승인', '완료')
mapper.update: update approval_line set status = #{status}, comment = #{comment}, signature_data = #{signatureData}, approved_at = current_timestamp where line_id = #{lineId}

update approval_document set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, completed_at = case when #{completed} = true then current_timestamp else completed_at end where document_id = #{documentId}

update fault_report f set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, resolved_at = case when #{resolved} = true then current_timestamp else resolved_at end from approval_document ad where ad.fault_id = f.fault_id and ad.document_id = #{documentId}

update complaint c set status = #{status}, admin_memo = coalesce(#{adminMemo}, admin_memo), updated_at = current_timestamp, closed_at = case when #{closed} = true then current_timestamp else closed_at end from fault_report f join approval_document ad on ad.fault_id = f.fault_id where f.complaint_id = c.complaint_id and ad.document_id = #{documentId} and f.complaint_id is not null
mapper.insert: insert into maintenance_action ( fault_id , inspection_id , approval_document_id , charger_id , employee_id , action_type , action_result , status , started_at , created_at , updated_at ) select f.fault_id , ad.inspection_id , ad.document_id , f.charger_id , #{employeeId} , #{actionType} , #{actionResult} , '진행중' , current_timestamp , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from approval_document ad join fault_report f on ad.fault_id = f.fault_id where ad.document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from maintenance_action where approval_document_id = #{documentId} and status = '진행중'
